scope_limit: Mechanism diagnostic only; no success-rate or formal-latency claim.

relative_action_rmse.comparison_scope: each action is compared only with BF16 from the same case_id and sampler_seed
relative_action_rmse.primary_metric: first 10 steps x 6 motor coordinates RMSE in normalized action units
relative_action_rmse.normalization: primary and secondary RMSE may be divided by the same-region BF16 RMS; undefined when that RMS is zero

native_a4_vs_independent_reference_actio.comparison_scope: native all-A4 raw action versus independent-reference raw action in the same case and sampler seed
native_a4_vs_independent_reference_actio.primary_metric: first 10 steps x 6 motor coordinates RMSE

factorial_effects.response: absolute RMSE over first 10 steps x 6 motor coordinates versus same-context BF16
factorial_effects.method: complete 2^3 descriptive contrasts, paired within case and sampler seed; no p-values

video_x_action_x_proprio.contrast: signed sum over the complete 2x2x2 cells (4=+1, 8=-1)

local_trace.grouping: scope x actually observed denoising stage x scheduler step
